[patterns/application/rules-engine/README.md#overview]

## Overview

This directory contains architectural patterns for implementing business logic using the appropriate approach — from embedded code modules through decision tables to full rules engine integration. These patterns support the [Rules Engine Qualification Guidance](../../../strategy/guidance/application/rules-engine/GUID-APP-RUL-001-rules-engine-qualification-guidance.md) by providing concrete, language-specific implementation guidance for each qualified approach.
page_texts.3:
[patterns/application/rules-engine/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Enable delivery teams to implement business logic at the right level of complexity for the problem:

- Avoid over-engineering by providing structured patterns for simpler approaches (embedded code, decision tables) that do not require a full rules engine runtime
- Avoid under-engineering by providing patterns for rules engine integration when qualification criteria are met
- Ensure testability and auditability across all approaches
- Align implementation with enterprise governance, PHI handling requirements, and CI/CD practices
page_texts.4:
[patterns/application/rules-engine/README.md#target-audience]

## Target Audience

- **Solution Architects**: Selecting the appropriate business logic implementation approach after completing the qualification framework
- **Development Teams**: Implementing the selected approach using language-specific guidance
- **Enterprise Architects**: Reviewing solution designs that propose rules engine adoption

> **Before using these patterns**, complete the qualification assessment in [GUID-APP-RUL-001 — Rules Engine Qualification Guidance](../../../strategy/guidance/application/rules-engine/GUID-APP-RUL-001-rules-engine-qualification-guidance.md).
